jobs.title: Founding Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
🚀 Looking for a Founding Chief Engineer

I'm building an early-stage technology company focused on solving a real problem in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering & Construction) industry, starting with engineering and design compliance
workflows.

I'm looking for a technically strong person who can take genuine ownership of the technology and engineering side of the company
. This is not simply a developer role
. I'm looking for someone who can think architecturally, make sound technical decisions independently, build hands-on, and eventually lead the technical organisation as we grow.

The opportunity

I already have an initial proof-of-concept and a clear problem developing to solve. I am now looking for someone who can take that early foundation and help turn it into a robust, scalable product
.
You'll work directly with me as the founder, with significant ownership over the technical direction and how we build the company from the ground up.

What you'll own

Technical leadership & ownership

Own the overall technical direction and architecture
Translate product and customer requirements into robust technical solutions
Make independent decisions around technology, architecture and infrastructure
Evaluate technical risks, trade-offs and build-vs-buy decisions
Define the technical roadmap from POC → production
Establish engineering, testing, security and deployment practices
Determine what we should build ourselves, integrate or outsource
Eventually recruit and lead the engineering team as the company grows

Hands-on engineering

Develop frontend and backend applications
Build APIs, databases and integrations
Work with cloud infrastructure and deployment
Develop engineering/compliance logic
Work with CAD/DWG and engineering data
Explore and integrate AI/ML or computer vision where it genuinely adds value
Review and improve the existing POC and technical foundation

Who I am looking for

You may currently be a Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead, Solutions Architect, Engineering Manager, CTO or experienced technical founder
. The title matters less than your ability to take ownership of the technology
.

I am particularly looking for someone with:
Strong full-stack software development experience
Strong understanding of software architecture and system design
Experience building and deploying production applications
Experience with cloud infrastructure and modern development practices
The ability to make sound technical decisions independently
Strong problem-solving and engineering fundamentals
A willingness to be hands-on and write code, not just manage engineers
The ability to eventually build and lead an engineering team

AEC experience ( AEC experience is strongly preferred)
I am particularly interested in people with experience in:

Civil engineering
Traffic engineering
Structural engineering
Architecture
Construction technology
BIM
CAD / engineering software

Experience working with CAD/DWG processing, geometry, AI/ML, computer vision or engineering data
would be a significant advantage.

That said, strong technical capability comes first
. AEC domain knowledge can be developed; the ability to architect and build a robust product is critical.

What’s being offered?

This will initially be a fractional engagement
, allowing the right person to contribute alongside existing commitments. The exact title and structure can be flexible depending on experience.

For the right individual, there is potential to grow the role into a full-time CTO / technical co-founder position
as the company develops. Compensation will be structured based on experience, commitment and scope, with potential equity participation
for the right long-term fit.

Why join? You'll have the opportunity to:

Take genuine ownership of the technology from the ground up
Work directly with the founder and shape the product
Solve a real-world problem at the intersection of AEC, software and AI

Turn an existing POC into a production-grade product

Establish the technical foundation of a new company

Potentially grow into a core leadership / co-founder role

I'm not looking for someone who simply wants another development project. I'm looking for someone who can become the technical counterpart to the business founder and help build the company with me.

If you're interested — or know someone who might be a great fit — please send us a direct message or send your email over to davidtan.onetranspire@gmail.com
with your LinkedIn profile/CV and a brief introduction about what you've built.

#Hiring #FractionalCTO #CTO #TechnicalCoFounder #AEC #ConstructionTech #Engineering #AI #SaaS #Startup

jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer - EA SPORTS™ FC
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games.

Building on an incredible 30-year foundation, we're redefining football with EA SPORTS FC - a genre-leading ecosystem of interactive experiences, bringing a global community of football fans closer to The World's Game. Together, we're taking the largest football club in the world to new heights – and this is just the beginning!

With more opportunity than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to fans everywhere, we invite you to join us as we pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS FC, and welcome everyone to the club!

Responsibilities

As a .NET Full Stack Software Engineer - EA SPORTS™ FC
, you are an essential part of the game creation process and are involved in the architectural design and implementation of the Content Tools.

Reporting to the Development Director, we are looking for an experienced .NET Full-Stack Software Engineer with web development experience and an in-depth understanding of C#/.NET and Single Page Application frameworks. You have experience in both designing and developing RESTful applications, and have the desire to deliver without sacrificing quality.

As a central team within the EA SPORTS™ FC project, our team delivers the tools that are used by Live Content producers to support many dynamic features in our game. As such, you would work with our internal customers to develop new features or upgrade existing ones. Whether you prefer working on new functionality, improving existing implementation, or fixing production issues, you will have the chance to contribute to applications that have an impact across the entire EA SPORTS™ FC project.

You will work with internal partners to design, develop, and deliver new features or upgrade existing ones
You will participate in planning sessions and daily SCRUM-style stand-up meetings
You will ensure the quality of the code by participating in the code review process
You will solve complex technical issues in a time-sensitive fashion
You will coach junior team members

Required Technical Skills

C#, .NET 10, JavaScript, TypeScript
Experience with designing RESTful APIs
Single Page Application frameworks such as Angular, React or Vue.js
Experience in writing efficient SQL queries
Experience with source control software such as Git or Perforce
Excellent debugging skills

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent
High level of proficiency with C# and an understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript
6+ years of professional software development experience
Experience designing maintainable, structured, and documented code

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  Lab Automation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to

models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The newComputational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients Worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

As a senior lab automation software engineer, you will be the essential link to the automation scientists in the lab. Using your background in both software development and hardware integration, you will work with a team of software-focused engineers to build, test and do what is needed to bring the software and hardware layers into production.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

Design, program and troubleshoot high-throughput lab workflows
Build orchestration systems, hardware abstraction layers, and instrument drivers that manage retries and allow unattended operation
Implement logging, metrics, and alerts across hardware and software to identify failures. Fix root causes using software or vision models instead of relying on manual workarounds or vendor support
Build systems to maintain a digital representation of the lab, including sample identity, instrument state, and resource availability. Connect instruments via APIs and integrate with LIMS and ELNs
Manage hardware requirements, site constraints, reagent selection, and work cell integration from initial design to deployment
Work directly with software engineers, automation scientists, and hardware engineers to turn scientific processes into technical architectures

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering and hardware integration
Experienced in programming commercial liquid-handling or laboratory automation platforms and integrating robotic manipulators
Proficient in C# or Python for building software and integration frameworks
Familiar with molecular biology, biochemistry, or wet lab workflows to help translate scientific needs into engineering solutions
Prototyping design experience, including CNC milling, laser cutting, and CAD
A clear communicator who collaborates with scientists and multidisciplinary teams to build complete solutions
Skilled at using APIs and SDKs to interact with complex laboratory software ecosystems
Experienced in designing workflow orchestration or scheduling systems that manage shared resources, dependencies, and priorities

Preferred Skills And Experience

Skilled with computer vision models (such as OpenCV, YOLO, or SAM) for automated error handling and object or anomaly detection
Experienced in training, evaluating, or adopting AI/ML models, including reinforcement or imitation learning for robotics
Capable of building and evaluating AI-enabled systems, defining evals, establishing guardrails for determinism versus nondeterminism, and measuring reliability
Knowledgeable about sensors, microcontrollers, and task-and-motion planning
Familiar with cloud infrastructure and digital twin simulation

A cover letter is not necessary, you will be required to fill a questionnaire.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity! #ComputationCoE

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
